exposure: reduced-port robotic surgery (RPRS) for uterine myomectomy
cohort: 115 patients who underwent RPRS for uterine myomectomy between April 2016 and July 2021.
finding: RPRS for uterine myomectomy is a safe and feasible treatment modality with acceptable long-term outcomes.
mod_finding: Out of 4 patients who became pregnant after RPRS, 3 delivered via cesarean section without complications.
